questions.enonce: Quel temps le mot-clé « last year » impose-t-il ?
questions.explication: Un moment fini du passé (last year, five years ago, yesterday) demande le prétérit.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: Right now, engineers ........ (develop) more sustainable batteries.
questions.explication: « Right now » appelle le présent continu (be + -ing). Les ingénieurs font l'action : actif.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: By the end of 2025, many companies ........ (launch) repair programs.
questions.explication: « By + date passée » : une action terminée avant ce repère, donc past perfect (had + participe passé).
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: A large amount of e-waste ........ (export) illegally every year.
questions.explication: Le déchet subit l'action (passif). « Every year » : présent simple. « A large amount » est singulier : is.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: At the moment, old computers ........ (collect) by volunteers.
questions.explication: « At the moment » + passif : are being + participe passé.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: Last year, several recycling centres ........ (build) in the country.
questions.explication: Prétérit passif : were + participe passé. « Build » est irrégulier : built.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: Over the past few years, awareness of e-waste ........ (increase) significantly.
questions.explication: « Over the past few years » : present perfect. « Awareness » est singulier : has.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: For several years now, environmental groups ........ (campaign) for better e-waste management.
questions.explication: « For several years now » : action qui dure jusqu'à maintenant, present perfect continu. Actif.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.enonce: More information campaigns should ........ (create) to raise awareness.
questions.explication: Modal + be + participe passé : le sujet (campaigns) subit l'action.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)

questions.explication: Les consommateurs agissent : actif. Après un modal, la base verbale sans « to ».
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 1 (verbes)
